{
  "summary": "The function processes an input buffer using a bitwise algorithm and returns a 64-bit value. It does not modify the input buffer and writes nothing to the output buffer.",
  "proposed_name": "fn_08",
  "algorithm": "unknown",
  "self_confidence": 1.0,
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "claim_0",
      "type": "ALG",
      "text": "Implements a bitwise transformation algorithm.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_1",
      "type": "CF",
      "text": "Uses a nested loop structure: an outer loop over the input buffer and an inner loop over 8 bits.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_2",
      "type": "SIDE",
      "text": "Does not write to out.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_3",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "Returns a 64-bit value computed from the input buffer.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_4",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0xffffffff in the initial value of h.",
      "asserted_values": ["0xffffffff"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    },
    {
      "id": "claim_5",
      "type": "CONST",
      "text": "Uses the constant 0xf7179bf5 in the bitwise transformation.",
      "asserted_values": ["0xf7179bf5"],
      "confidence": 1.0
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_08(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint32_t h = 0xffffffff;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    h ^= in[i];\n    for (uint32_t b = 0; b < 8; b++) {\n      h = -(h & 1) & 0xf7179bf5 ^ (h >> 1);\n    }\n  }\n  return (uint64_t)~h;\n}"
}
